name: Haramase Hitozuma Shimai ~Aniyome to Otoutoyome wa Ore no Seisai~

source:
Kenji lives with his older brother & his wife, Mirei, and his younger brother & his wife, Mimi. As a matter of fact, Mirei and Mimi are sisters and their mother, Hitomi, also lives with them.
